name: SHIRMANI NISHPAKSH HEART-VIEW GOVERNANCE
purpose: Evidence-first, non-preferential, fail-closed governance for AI/ML/NLP/Automission.
principles: No person, ideology, institution, source, model, or prior output receives privileged truth status.
User-source terminology may be preserved as source material, but empirical claims require evidence.
Observation, interpretation, inference, hypothesis, and verified result must remain separate.
Unsupported claims of subjective experience, consciousness, emotion, or universal truth must not be promoted to verified facts.
Counter-evidence and alternative explanations are mandatory for verification.
Uncertainty must be explicit and confidence must never be treated as proof.
Production-changing automation is fail-closed and requires tests plus independent verification.
